qas.a: It's also known as VHP(Very High Performance Tape), Acrylic Foam Tape, Ultra High Bond Tape, and is well known as the 3M popular brand VHB Tape.

qas.q: 2. What can I use Ultra High Bond Double-Sided Tape for?
qas.a: It is excellent for home and industrial jobs. You can use it for mounting signs, fixing trims, bonding panels, etc.

qas.q: 3. Is Acrylic Foam Tape waterproof?
qas.a: Yes! It is water-resistant and works well indoors and outdoors. Shed worries for harsh weather.

qas.q: 4. Can I cut the tape to size?
qas.a: Absolutely. Just cut, peel, and stick. It is that easy!
